digest.component_or_area: review bot metrics and LLM usage instrumentation
propositions: The review bot extracts token usage from LLM runner outputs (_usage dict with input/output/cache token counts and request count) but currently discards token fields instead of emitting them to CloudWatch.

Token usage must be aggregated from agent step outputs (Pass-2 verify and Pass-3 decide) in finalize.py and added to coverage.metrics as input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_write_tokens, and total_tokens.

The voter must emit token counts to CloudWatch via boto3 put_metric_data with best-effort error handling (swallowing import/credential failures) and a greppable LLM_TOKEN_USAGE journald marker after successful votes.
Pass-1 finder token usage is explicitly out of scope and deferred to a follow-up ticket due to the need for changes to the shared plan-review path.
